answers.question: What does the TradeHQ portfolio tracker show?
answers.renderedAnswer: It tracks simulated positions, realized and unrealized P&L, day change, maximum drawdown, open-position P&L dispersion, allocation snapshots and an automated growth summary. Asset prices may be live, cached, delayed or simulated depending on data availability.

answers.question: Are the portfolio statistics based on real prices?
answers.renderedAnswer: Not always. TradeHQ can use live, cached, delayed or simulated quotes depending on the asset and data availability. Status badges indicate the source when available. The portfolio is an educational simulation, not a brokerage account.

answers.question: How do I reset my virtual portfolio?
answers.renderedAnswer: Guest records are browser-held; clearing site data removes the local copy. Signed-in cash and open positions can also have a synced account copy when the service is available. Clearing browser data does not delete or reset that account copy. Trade history, journals and course progress remain browser-held.
